Name: ZH's EBAGI - Ridgeside Village
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/bMAloRr.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]﻿
[left]This EBAGI mod was made to be paired up with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods[/url] mod, adding EBAGI icons for all available artisan goods, which currently includes: Dried Mushrooms, Honey, Jelly, Juice, Pickles and Wine.
Whenever/If EBAGI updates to allow Aged Roe and Dried Fruits like in their plans, then they will be added. [/left]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/fgAIaVq.png[/img]﻿[/center]Until I figure out an easier way to change the styles around, this is currently how to change the styles. If a more experienced modder knows how I can do this, please feel free to let me know it would be a big help!

1. Inside the mod folder, there is both an Assets and All_Assets folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9JLbgZd.png[/img]

Assets is what will[i] [/i][u][i]appear in game[/i][/u]
All_Assets has all available options to choose from

2. You need to replace the .png files in Assets folder with the ones that you want. Go through the All_Assets folder to find the pattern and colour you want to use.

﻿[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mXuCG7e.png[/img]﻿[/center]

3. [u]IMPORTANT:[/u] Make sure that the .png files you replace in the Assets folder have the correct file name. If you change the names in any way, then it will not work. The correct names are shown in the image above this point.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pcnCZXd.png[/img][/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url].
3. Download the .zip file from this mod and install it

You're all done and ready to play.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/p4jIsMj.png[/img][/center]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url], Mamaesh, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/123997133?tab=user+files]ch20youk[/url] and the Ridgeside Village Council. Thank you for all the hard work you've all put in to this amazing mod
